messages:
ben: Observed a sudden spike in observer throttles after the rollout at 02:00Z. eu1 synth p95 jumped and I'm seeing ~8% 429s on /v1/generate

maya: Which rollout? can you paste deploy-bot output? @deploy-bot

deploy-bot: deploy 2026-03-21T02:00Z -> prod started. Canary 10% -> 50% -> 100%. Post-deploy smoke: prefills OK, kv-warmup OK, synth-check: 429_rate=8%, p95=1.82s

ben: Here's the quick log snippet:
```
[03:12:44] synth-check eu1: 200: 92, 429: 8, p95: 1820ms
[03:12:50] route: observer-agent rate_limit triggered, inflight backpressure
```

alice: Noted. Is this affecting user-facing latency or just synthetic probes? any errors in runtime logs?

ben: Mostly synths and observer-side calls. Some user requests show tail latency increase but low error-rate. Looks like observer-side queue throttle kicking in.

charlie: Re-route idea: pin the route to older model variant in eu1 while we investigate? Targeted per-region pin should avoid full rollback.

maya: +1 to pin. Start with a canary pin to 20260320-rc3 for eu1. If deploy-bot can flip routing per-region we can avoid broad rollback.

infra-bot: Created incident ticket #INC-2026-042. Paging oncall.

ben: Agree. Maya, can you run the pin? I'll stand by to open rollback if pin doesn't reduce 429s within 5 minutes.

maya: Pinning now. Command:
```
runbook pin-route --region eu1 --route observer --to 20260320-rc3 --ttl 30m
```

deploy-bot: Route pin applied for eu1 -> 20260320-rc3. Verifying synthetic probes...

deploy-bot: synth-check eu1: 200: 99, 429: 1, p95: 420ms

ben: Nice, that's a clear improvement. Hold rollout and monitor for 15m. If stable, we'll unpin and roll forward with a staggered batch.

charlie: I'll dig into the new variant's observer client changes; possible connection pooling regression. Assigning to me.

maya: I'll update release notes with the pin and decision. Adding a short note to the changelog and the release ticket.

ben: Quick checklist: 1) incident ticket created 2) pin applied 3) monitor 15m 4) if stable, continue staggered rollout 5) otherwise prepare rollback to previous deploy id.

maya: Updating #release-notes and will ping #product-postmortem if needed. :eyes:

charlie: Found a suspect commit in connection pool sizing, testing a patch locally and will roll a small canary.

ben: Thanks all — keeping this thread for handoff. I'll post status update at +15m.

deploy-bot: synth-check eu1 (15m): 200: 99.7, 429: 0.3, p95: 410ms

ben: Hold complete — unpin and resume staggered rollout in next window. Keeping incident open for followups.
